title: 第十四章   终被发现，逃亡开始
content_zh:
天刚蒙蒙亮，琼霄却已经来到了地黄狮的领地，朝着周围的密林就是一阵乱劈。

    吼！硕大的身体顿时极速的冲了出来，望着冲出来的地黄狮，琼霄嘿嘿一笑：“终于出来了啊，前几天追的我可爽啊！今天小爷我可要找回场子了。”

    地黄狮那双通红的大眼睛紧紧的盯着琼霄，从眼中流露出残暴的神情，不停的走来走去，似乎在寻找着空隙，准备发动一击致命的攻击。“嘿嘿！这么聪明，你不动手，那我先动手了，”琼霄咧咧嘴旋即朝着地黄狮冲去。铛，铛，铛，一阵阵破风的声音随着战斗开始响了起来，战斗的冲击波携带着满天的尘土冲刷着着周围的树木，树叶随着冲击波的冲刷剧烈的摇动起来，仿佛有着滚滚鼓声震天响起，似乎在为一人一兽的战斗加油助威。

    嘭！琼霄倒飞而出，双脚重重的落在地上，后退了十数丈之远，前方的地黄狮也倒退了数丈。“好家伙！还是这么厉害！”琼霄满脸凝重的盯着地黄狮，旋即双手迅速动了起来，“风神怒，一拳震地裂，”琼霄一拳轰在了地上随即背后的虚影也随着琼霄的动作也是一拳轰在了地上。随着琼霄进入**境，有了足够的星力支持琼霄挥霍，对于风神决的使用也越发的成熟。砰，砰，砰！一道凌厉的攻击从地上直奔地黄狮而来，一个个坑洞随着攻击掠过而出现在地上。地黄狮紧紧盯着前来的攻击后退了几步然后双脚重重踏地，旋即从双脚中散发出强劲的能量防护。嘭！琼霄的攻击攻击在了防护罩上，霎时两股能量相互割据侵蚀着。“给我破！”一声低吼从琼霄口中传出。嘭！又是一道攻击轰在了防护罩上，那防护罩出现了密密麻麻的裂纹，砰！能量防护罩化为漫天碎屑。轰，琼霄的攻击最终击中了地黄狮的身体，地黄狮那硕大的身体被弹了起来，最后落在了地上。

    吼～一阵凄厉的声音不断的响起，地黄狮艰难的爬了起来，气息变得萎靡起来。“哼，再接我一招，风神掌！风起云涌！”琼霄低沉一声，一股强劲的能量龙卷风冲天而起，迅速朝着地黄狮席卷而去。比起先前，琼霄的攻击越发的凌厉强劲，望着而来的攻势，地黄狮感到了强烈的死亡气息，随即立即用尽最后的力量抵御着琼霄的攻击，但地黄狮的防御节节败退，最终被卷入能量龙卷风之中，强劲的龙卷风直直而去，十数棵大树拦腰折断。嘭！能量龙卷风突然消失，地黄狮的身体重重落在了地上，砸出了一个深坑，此刻的地黄狮血肉模糊，气息萎靡不振，双目不甘的盯着缓步走来的琼霄，口中不停的流露出阵阵虚弱的吼声。“真是难缠，”琼霄有些虚脱的看了看深坑中的地黄狮，随后跳了下去踩在了地黄狮身上一剑刺了下去，一颗灵核被取了出来，地黄狮的生机也随着灵核被取出而泯灭。

    跳出了深坑的琼霄旋即盘坐在地上恢复起来。

    “好精彩的战斗！”一道声音突然响起，“谁？”琼霄随即睁开双眼紧盯着着前方的草丛。

    “呵呵，你不认识我们，不过我们可是知道你是谁啊！”一道道身影从周围的草丛中跳了出来。琼霄望了望周围的人，足足有上百人之多，先前他只顾着和地黄狮战斗，没有注意到周围的异动。

    “好大的阵仗，你们到底是谁，为何要围堵我？”琼霄紧盯着前方一位中年男子说道。周围的人实力皆在化星境巅峰，比起杜狼的天狼团更为强大。

    “呵呵，在下是万剑宗宗主范森，我今日只是来验证一下，这位小兄弟是否和我师弟的死有关系，并无他想。”中年男子笑道。

    “你师弟是谁，我只是一个在死亡山脉修行的人，我怎么会杀了你的师弟？”琼霄警惕道。

    中年男子望着琼霄，眼里流露出一丝的凶狠：“是吗？请问小兄弟是否认识天狼雇佣兵团长杜狼？”

    “你说的是谁？我不认识，我在这里修行那么久，你们是我第一批遇见的人，”琼霄沉声说道。

    “呵呵，小兄弟还记得天狼雇佣兵团唯一的幸存者韩生吧！他可把你的一切告诉了我，你身后的那把重剑就是最好的证据，琼霄！”
content_en:
It was just dawn, but Qiong Xiao had already arrived at the territory of the Dihuang Lion, and was slashing at the surrounding dense forest.

    roar! The huge body rushed out at a very fast speed. Looking at the Dihuang Lion rushing out, Qiong Xiao chuckled: "It's finally out. I was so happy chasing it a few days ago! Today, I'm going to regain my place."

    The big red eyes of Dihuang Lion were staring at Qiong Xiao tightly, with a cruel look in his eyes. He kept walking around, as if looking for an opening, preparing to launch a fatal attack. "Hey! You are so smart. If you don't take action, then I will take action first," Qiong Xiao grinned and rushed towards the Dihuang Lion. Dang, Dang, Dang, bursts of wind-breaking sounds began to sound as the battle began. The shock wave of the battle carried dust all over the sky and washed away the surrounding trees. The leaves shook violently as the shock wave washed away, as if the sound of rolling drums was ringing in the sky, seeming to cheer for the battle between one man and one beast.

    Bang! Qiong Xiao flew out upside down, landed heavily on the ground with both feet, and retreated more than ten feet. The Dihuang Lion in front also retreated several feet. "Good guy! Still so powerful!" Qiong Xiao stared at the Dihuang Lion solemnly, and then quickly moved his hands, "The Wind God was angry, and his punch shook the ground." Qiong Xiao punched the ground, and then the shadow behind him also punched the ground following Qiong Xiao's movements. As Qiong Xiao entered the ** realm, he had enough star power to support Qiong Xiao's squandering, and his use of Fengshen Jue became more and more mature. Bang, bang, bang! A fierce attack came straight from the ground to the Yellow Lion, and pits appeared on the ground as the attack passed by. The Dihuang Lion stared closely at the incoming attack and took a few steps back before slamming his feet on the ground, immediately emitting powerful energy protection from his feet. Bang! Qiong Xiao's attack hit the protective shield, and instantly the two energies separated and eroded each other. "Break it!" A low roar came from Qiong Xiao's mouth. Bang! Another attack hit the protective shield, and dense cracks appeared on the protective shield. Bang! The energy shield turned into debris all over the sky. Boom, Qiong Xiao's attack finally hit Dihuang Lion's body. Dihuang Lion's huge body was bounced up and finally fell to the ground.

    Roar~ A shrill sound kept ringing, and the Dihuang Lion climbed up with difficulty, its breath becoming weak. "Hmph, take another move from me, Wind Divine Palm! The wind is rising!" Qiong Xiao let out a low voice, and a powerful tornado of energy rose into the sky and quickly swept towards the Dihuang Lion. Compared with before, Qiong Xiao's attack became more fierce and powerful. Looking at the incoming attack, Dihuang Lion felt a strong aura of death, and immediately used his last strength to resist Qiong Xiao's attack. However, Dihuang Lion's defense retreated steadily, and was finally involved in the energy tornado. The powerful tornado went straight away, and dozens of big trees were broken in the middle. Bang! The energy tornado suddenly disappeared, and the Dihuang Lion's body fell heavily on the ground, creating a deep pit. At this moment, the Dihuang Lion was covered in blood and flesh, and its breath was sluggish. Its eyes were unwillingly staring at Qiong Xiao, who was walking slowly, and bursts of weak roars kept coming from his mouth. "It's really difficult." Qiong Xiao looked at the Dihuang Lion in the pit with some exhaustion, then jumped down and stepped on the Dihuang Lion and stabbed it with a sword. A spiritual core was taken out, and the Dihuang Lion's vitality was also extinguished with the removal of the spiritual core.

    Qiong Xiao, who jumped out of the pit, immediately sat cross-legged on the ground and recovered.

    "What an exciting battle!" A voice suddenly sounded, "Who?" Qiong Xiao then opened his eyes and stared at the grass in front of him.

    "Haha, you don't know us, but we know who you are!" Figures jumped out from the surrounding grass. Qiong Xiao looked at the people around him, there were hundreds of them. Previously, he was only focused on fighting the Dihuang Lion and didn't notice any changes around him.

    "What a huge battle. Who are you and why are you surrounding me?" Qiong Xiao said, staring closely at a middle-aged man in front of him. The strength of the people around them is all at the peak of the Star Transformation Realm, and they are more powerful than Du Lang's Sirius Group.

    "Haha, this is Fan Sen, the leader of the Ten Thousand Sword Sect. I'm just here today to verify whether this little brother has anything to do with my junior brother's death. I have no other ideas." The middle-aged man said with a smile.

    "Who is your junior brother? I am just a person who practices in the Death Mountain. How could I kill your junior brother?" Qiong Xiao asked warily.

    The middle-aged man looked at Qiong Xiao with a trace of ferocity in his eyes: "Really? Does my little brother know Du Lang, the leader of the Sirius mercenary group?"

    "Who are you talking about? I don't know you. I have been practicing here for so long, and you are the first people I met," Qiong Xiao said in a deep voice.

    "Haha, little brother, remember Han Sheng, the only survivor of the Sirius Mercenary Group! He told me everything about you. The heavy sword behind you is the best evidence, Qiong Xiao!"
title_en: Chapter 14: Finally discovered, the escape begins
